record.hypothesis: A successful required Homebrew test-bot check proves every nested formula install and test completed successfully.
record.attempted_change: Prepared to merge CAS formula PR #21 after both required test-bot checks reported SUCCESS at the exact head.
record.observed_outcome: The Ubuntu check concluded SUCCESS even though its nested brew test --verbose tkersey/tap/cas command reported FAILED, annotated tkersey/tap/cas: failed and test failed, and raised a Minitest assertion after cas review_session --help returned OutOfMemory.

source_refs.summary: The Ubuntu required check concluded SUCCESS while its formula-test log recorded a terminal failure.
Log lines 330-358 show brew test --verbose, FAILED, cas review_session OutOfMemory, and expected 0 actual 1 at Formula/cas.rb.
The guarded merge was stopped at exact head 0308ffbfaf34d324ed2ad608b977ea765bb28a85.

falsifying_evidence: GitHub statusCheckRollup reported test-bot (ubuntu-latest) conclusion SUCCESS.
The same job log reported brew test --verbose tkersey/tap/cas followed by FAILED.
The job emitted error annotation tkersey/tap/cas: failed and warning annotation test failed.
The formula test raised Minitest::Assertion Expected: 0 Actual: 1 after the dispatcher reported failed to launch cas_review_session: OutOfMemory.
record.exclusion_rule: Do not accept a green Homebrew test-bot check as formula-release proof when the job can return success after a nested brew test failure; inspect the formula-test result and annotations or require a wrapper that propagates the nested failure before merging.
applicability_conditions: A Homebrew tap PR uses brew test-bot --only-formulae as a required hosted check.
The workflow or test-bot version can conclude success after reporting a skipped or failed formula.
Merge closure requires successful tap-qualified installation and formula tests, not only a green GitHub check conclusion.

reopening_criteria.condition: The tap workflow is verified with a known failing formula to return a nonzero job conclusion whenever brew test-bot reports a failed formula.
A required post-test verifier rejects FAILED formula results and test-failure annotations before the job can conclude success.

record.next_search_hint: Inspect the complete --only-formulae log and job annotations, then make nested formula failures terminal at the workflow boundary.

record.hypothesis: Adding --fail-fast to brew test-bot --only-formulae causes a nested formula test failure to propagate as a nonzero workflow step and job conclusion.
record.attempted_change: Added --fail-fast to the pull-request brew test-bot --only-formulae invocation in Homebrew tap PR #21 and reran both hosted jobs.
record.observed_outcome: The Ubuntu formula test still failed, TestBot reported one failed step ignored and listed tkersey/tap/cas under skipped or failed formulae, yet the TestBot step and GitHub job both concluded SUCCESS.

source_refs.summary: Exact-head Ubuntu rerun with --fail-fast concluded SUCCESS despite the nested formula failure.
Log lines 308-376 show brew test FAILED, OutOfMemory, skipped or failed formulae tkersey/tap/cas, and Warning: 1 failed step ignored.
The attempted workflow repair added --fail-fast at the exact PR head.

falsifying_evidence: The nested brew test --verbose tkersey/tap/cas command reported FAILED and Expected 0 Actual 1.
TestBot reported Skipped or failed formulae: tkersey/tap/cas and Warning: 1 failed step ignored.
The enclosing Ubuntu job concluded SUCCESS.
record.exclusion_rule: Do not rely on brew test-bot --only-formulae --fail-fast alone to make an ignored nested formula failure terminal; inspect TestBot's skipped_or_failed_formulae step output with a separate failing workflow gate.
applicability_conditions: A Homebrew tap workflow uses brew test-bot --only-formulae as formula-release proof.
TestBot records nested formula failures as skipped_or_failed_formulae while intentionally ignoring the failed nested step.
The workflow needs the GitHub job conclusion to fail when any formula is skipped or failed.

reopening_criteria.condition: A pinned future Homebrew TestBot version is verified with a known failing formula to make --only-formulae --fail-fast return nonzero without a separate output gate.

record.next_search_hint: Give the formulae step an id and fail a following always() step when steps.<id>.outputs.skipped_or_failed_formulae is non-empty.
